title: Report Re A.M. Zaslavsky, Soviet Merchant

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date January 15, 1935.
Subject A. M. Zaslavsky, Soviet merchant.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by.

Information has been received that Abram Kemelevitch
Zaslavsky, residing at No. 857 Avenue Joffre, is a Soviet
informer. He is a Soviet citizen of Jewish origin, who
was born on 17.8.1899, in Tavrida Province, South Russia.
He holds Soviet passport No. 104452 issued on 21.12.1925,
at Chita, Transbaikal Province. Zaslavsky arrived at
Shanghai from Manchuria a few years ago. Upon his arrival
in this city, he was employed as a shop assistant with K. F.
Miller Haberdashery Store, No. 21A Szechuen Road, until
1931 when he opened his own Haberdashery Store at No. 859
Avenue Joffre. On January 6, 1935 Zaslavsky opened a
branch of his enterprise at No. 1159 Bubbling Well Road.
It is rumoured that he is financed by the Moscow Narodny
Bank. It is reported that Zaslavsky frequently visits
the local U.S.S.R. Consulate-General, and that he is on
friendly terms with many local Soviet agents.

D. S. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch)
